title: EEG Pre/Post Intervention Dataset
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings collected to examine changes in neural activity before and after an intervention. Participants are divided into three groups and recorded in pre- and post-intervention sessions. The data are organized in BIDS format with EDF recordings, JSON sidecars, and event files, supporting signal analysis, functional connectivity studies, and pre/post comparisons.
methods_description: EEG data were recorded using standard acquisition systems. Recordings are organized by participant and session (pre/post intervention), with detailed acquisition parameters provided in JSON sidecar files accompanying each EEG recording.
